source_title: ILOSTAT SDMX API Data Dissemination Web Service Reference Guide V4.1
available_indicators: Employment by Sex and Economic activity (EMP_TEMP_SEX_ECO_NB)
Share of temporary employees by sex (EES_XTMP_SEX_RT)
country_coverage: All ILO member countries. Country grouping extensions available (e.g., X85_COU for BRICS: Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa). Countries identified by REF_AREA codes.

data_structure.protocol: SDMX RESTful API (partial implementation of SDMX Standards Section 7)
data_structure.filtering: Dot-separated dimension values with wildcarding and OR (+) operator support
data_structure.content_constraints: Actual Content Constraints (Availability) generated for each dataflow as CCA_<DF id>

version_history.changes: New Base URLs using HTTPS, Generic v2.1 default, CSV format added
JSON for structural metadata, country groups extension
SURVEY dimension removed, descriptive metadata reformatted
COLLECTION dimension removed, firstNObservations/lastNObservations fully implemented

example_queries: /dataflow/ILO - all dissemination dataflows (best for discovering data availability)
/categoryscheme/ILO - all categories (best for starting navigation of ILOSTAT data)

key_insights: ILOSTAT provides comprehensive labour statistics for all ILO member countries
API supports SDMX standard for statistical data exchange
Data available in multiple formats: XML, JSON, CSV
One dataflow defined per DSD/indicator for easy discovery
Content constraints show actual data availability per indicator
Can filter by country, sex, age, economic activity, time period
Supports time series queries with startPeriod/endPeriod
Descriptive metadata includes source notes, indicator notes, and classification notes
Old base URLs decommissioned June 2020 - must use new sdmx.ilo.org/rest endpoint
